newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway shares flat in moderate volume.
newsitem.headline: Norway shares flat in moderate volume.

text.p: Norwegian shares closed virtually unchanged in boring trade on Friday but the underlying sentiment in the market is strong, dealers said.
Oslo's Total share index, which soared to several life highs this week on the back of overseas developments, closed 0.06 points off at 1,268.98 for no percentage change at all.
Turnover was moderate at 955 million crowns.
"Its been a non-day, very boring," a dealer said. "Most blue chips had a quiet day. The focus was on some speculative shares such as Ocean Rig."
Ocean Rig was the second most traded share at 68.5 million crowns. It finished 6.76 percent, or one crown, higher at 15.80 crowns.
Industrial conglomerate Norsk Hydro, Norway's largest listed company, was the most traded stock at 81 million crowns. It ended marginally lower at 395.50 crowns.
"There still a strong underlying sentiment in the market but it is only natural that things quiet down after the bull run earlier this week," a dealer said.
